text:
Maya: Quick sync — post-launch micro-iteration proposal. After today's launch we have a few small regressions plus customer asks. I'm proposing a 1-week short wave: top 3 bug fixes (p0/p1 user-facing) + 1 small enhancement that unblocks an enterprise customer. Agree?
Noah: +1 if fixes are well-scoped. what's the list?
Maya: Draft list —
```
RWD-1423 session drop on long chat flows
RWD-1431 embeddings mismatch in search rerank
RWD-1440 tokenization edge-case for emojis
ENH-987 add optional request-level caching header
```
Li: UI for the error state (1423) looks quick to patch. I can take it, estimate 1.5d.
Aj: We saw a p99 spike tied to 1423, SLO alerted once. I'll pair with Li for a hotfix deploy plan.
Eden: Customer signal: three customers reported the embeddings mismatch, two are paying customers on Dedicated. Severity = high.
Maya: Ok owners: Li -> 1423, Noah -> 1431 + 1440, Maya -> ENH-987 (PM acceptance + tests). Can we commit to code, QA, canary, prod within 7 days?
Noah: Reasonable but need to drop scope if anything bigger shows up. Suggest feature toggle for ENH-987 so we can rollback quickly.
Li: Agree on toggle. I'll add QA steps and a screenshot test.
Aj: For deploy: propose canary % = 5% for first 24h, automated rollback on error rate > 2x baseline. I'll set the rollout in the release plan.
deploy-bot: Canary started for rwd/service@release/2026-03-23 (5% traffic)
Maya: Acceptance criteria for bugs: repro steps, unit + e2e where possible, fix validated on canary, no regression in tokenization tests. For enhancement: gated behind header + perf regression < 5%.
Eden: I'll add telemetry checks: embedding similarity distribution and customer impact dashboard. Will create eval prompts.
Noah: Timeline: PRs by Tue EOD, QA Wed, canary Thu, full rollout Fri if stable.
Maya: Sounds good. If blockers surface we'll reconvene Thu AM. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Li: I'll update tickets and add label `short-wave`.
Eden: pushing eval artifacts to /s3/redwood/postlaunch/wave1
Noah: tagging @support to notify the impacted customers once canary is stable.
Support Bot: Notifying customers RWD-1431, RWD-1423 (templates used)
Maya: logging this plan in the roadmap doc and attaching the tickets. Closing thread unless any objections.
Noah: no objections.
Aj: none from infra.
Maya: Thanks — moving to execution.
